lede: BYU carries the stronger underlying team rating — +3.0 against -6.7, a 9.7-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Colorado State +21.4 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with BYU winning 92% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is qb room, where BYU leads Colorado State by 71 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
